zh: 数据探索 → 业务库巡检与表字典：表名旁新增来源标识。NetCare 业务表标为青色「NetCare」，DataFab 看板表标为橙色「DataFab」；被看板 SQL 计算引用的表再叠加粉色「二次加工」。表目录里可以按来源一键筛选。
「导出字典 / 模板」改为导出 Excel，共两张表：表字典分「表标识 / 表字典 / 最新一键体检 / 字段明细」四组，各用一种颜色；来源、二次加工、体检状态按颜色区分，并带上行数、异常情况和样例收集结果。另附一张体检汇总页。导出的文件改完可以直接导回。
en: Data explorer → business DB watch & dictionary: tables now carry source badges next to their names: NetCare (teal), DataFab (orange), plus a pink Reprocessed badge for tables used by board SQL. The table catalog can be filtered by source.

Export dictionary / template now downloads an Excel workbook. Its dictionary sheet has colour-coded groups: identity, dictionary, latest health check and fields. Source, Reprocessed and check status are highlighted, with row counts, anomalies and sample results. A summary sheet is included, and the file can be edited and imported back.
